property.name: admin-username
property.description: Built-in administrator of Amoro. Ambari uses it for the REST API (catalog registration, optimizers, service check).

property.name: admin-password
property.description: Password of the built-in administrator of Amoro. No default: choose a strong secret.

property.name: server-bind-host
property.description: Address the Amoro services listen on.

property.name: http-server.bind-port
property.description: Port of the Amoro dashboard and REST APIs (HTTP or HTTPS).

property.name: thrift-server.table-service.bind-port
property.description: Thrift port of the Amoro table service.

property.name: thrift-server.optimizing-service.bind-port
property.description: Thrift port the optimizers connect to.

property.name: http-server.rest-auth-type
property.description: Authentication of the REST APIs: basic (built-in administrator, used by Ambari), token or jwt. Dashboard users log in with the login provider below.

property.name: http-server.login-auth-ldap-url
property.description: LDAP server(s) of the dashboard login (space-separated). When empty, only the built-in administrator can log in.

property.name: http-server.login-auth-ldap-user-pattern
property.description: DN of a dashboard user, {0} being the login name, for instance uid={0},cn=users,cn=accounts,dc=example,dc=com.

property.name: http-server.authorization.enabled
property.description: Dashboard RBAC: members of the admin LDAP group (amoro-env) are SERVICE_ADMIN, the other users get the default role.

property.name: http-server.authorization.default-role
property.description: Role of the LDAP users outside the admin group: VIEWER (read-only), or empty to refuse them.

property.name: http-server.authorization.ldap-role-mapping.group-member-attribute
property.description: Attribute of the admin LDAP group listing its members.

property.name: http-server.authorization.ldap-role-mapping.bind-dn
property.description: Optional DN binding to read the admin LDAP group (anonymous read when empty).

property.name: http-server.authorization.ldap-role-mapping.bind-password
property.description: Password of the bind DN reading the admin LDAP group.

property.name: http-server.ssl.enabled
property.description: Serve the dashboard and REST APIs over HTTPS.

property.name: http-server.ssl.keystore-path
property.description: Keystore of the dashboard and REST API TLS certificate; its key uses the keystore password. Required when TLS is enabled.
